title: Patrol route
prompt: The robot patrols a corner. Write `move`, which prints "forward", and `turn_left`, which prints "left". In `solve`, make it move, turn left, move, turn left, so the output is those four words in order.
hints: This is like driving a turtle: each call is one instruction, and the order is the route.
Two helpers with one print each.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
